_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja DirkWirman (106 terminow, ~24 mikroscen) - wspolny pokoj z pryczami dzielony przez Dirka i Wirmana. Zawiera zagadke maszyny do pisania Wirmana z ukrytym listem, walizke z woda po goleniu, oraz kluczowa scene AfterWirmanSuspicion, gdzie Grimoire dopytuje o zwiazek ojca Wirmana z Mortuga.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: Wait, Wirman - I had a question.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: Your father knew [i]Mortuga?[/i] You never mentioned that.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.pl: Twój ojciec znał [i]Mortugę?[/i] Nigdy o tym nie wspominałeś.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: Yeah, never met him. That's why the offer in the letter was so tempting.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.pl: Tak, nigdy go nie poznałem. Dlatego oferta w liście była tak kusząca.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: You'd not met Mortuga before you arrived here on the submarine, is that right?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.pl: Nie znałeś Mortugi, zanim dotarłeś tu, na łódź podwodną, zgadza się?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: Right, but then, where'd you get the information about him to inspire your [i]first[/i] book?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.pl: Dobrze, ale w takim razie skąd wziąłeś informacje o nim, które zainspirowały twoją [i]pierwszą[/i] książkę?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: The [i]first[/i] one? Oh, I just asked my father.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.en: He didn't - but, they, uh, had a mutual friend.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.pl: On go nie znał - ale mieli, yy, wspólnego znajomego.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_AfterWirman.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.en:
It's a bunk room.
It's pretty nice, honestly.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.pl:
To pokój z pryczami.
Jest całkiem miły, szczerze mówiąc.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.en: I'd [h]kill[/h] to have a bedroom this big.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.en: Oh, I'd just pick someone from my list.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.pl: Och, po prostu wybrałabym kogoś z mojej listy.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_BG/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.en: So now we can look at it?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.pl: Więc teraz możemy na to spojrzeć?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.en: We already unlocked the cell phone.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.en: You never know when you might have to go to a fancy party.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.pl: Nigdy nie wiadomo, kiedy trzeba będzie pójść na wystawne przyjęcie.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.en:
What d'you mean it's locked??
How can a phone be locked?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.pl:
Jak to zablokowany??
Jak telefon może być zablokowany?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.en: What's this in the front pocket...?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.pl: Co to jest w przedniej kieszeni...?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TuxCellphon.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterN.en: Let's at least talk to the guy, before we put our [i]grubby little hands[/i] all over his typewriter.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterN.pl: Porozmawiajmy chociaż z tym facetem, zanim położymy nasze [i]brudne łapska[/i] na jego maszynie do pisania.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterN.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.en: Did you notice the weird mechanism on the back?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.en: There's something strange about this typewriter.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.pl: Jest coś dziwnego w tej maszynie do pisania.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.en: We already solved the puzzle and found the handwritten letter.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.pl: Już rozwiązaliśmy tę zagadkę i znaleźliśmy odręczny list.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.en: It's Wirman's typewriter. I think it's also a puzzle.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.pl: To maszyna do pisania Wirmana. Chyba to też zagadka.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_TypewriterP.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.en: They're all classic fantasy adventure novels.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.pl: Wszystkie to klasyczne fantastyczne powieści przygodowe.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.en:
Oh, I've read this one!
[i]The Sapphire Sword.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.en: It's about a boy who learns how to travel between dimensions.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.pl: Jest o chłopcu, który uczy się podróżować między wymiarami.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.en:
Using the titular [i]sapphire sword[/i],
I presume.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.pl:
Za pomocą tytułowego [i]szafirowego miecza,[/i]
domyślam się.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_bookpiles/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.en: Yeah, but I can barely make sense of it.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.pl: Tak, ale ledwo mogę się w tym połapać.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.en: Kinda looks like an attempt at the first chapter of a story...
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.pl: Wygląda trochę jak próba napisania pierwszego rozdziału jakiejś historii...
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_discardedpa.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.en:
It's a huge iron dumbbell...
Made from nuts and bolts.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.pl:
To wielki żelazny hantel...
Zrobiony z nakrętek i śrub.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.en:
So...
You gonna pick it up?
Might be a clue.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.pl:
Więc...
Podniesiesz go?
Może być tropem.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.en:
Big blunt object like that...
Could be a weapon?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.pl:
Taki wielki, tępy przedmiot...
Mógłby być bronią?
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.en:
I'd say it looks [i]pretty suspicious.[/i]
Worth investigating.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.pl:
Powiedziałabym, że wygląda [i]dość podejrzanie.[/i]
Warto to zbadać.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_dumbbell/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.en:
Do they want rats?
[i]That's[/i] how you get rats.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.pl:
Chcą szczurów?
[i]Tak[/i] właśnie się je ściąga.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.en:
Either there are already rats,
or there are no rats.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.pl:
Albo już są tu szczury,
albo nie ma żadnych szczurów.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_food/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_hangingclot.en: I guess the submarine doesn't have a laundry room.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_hangingclot.pl: Chyba łódź podwodna nie ma pralni.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_hangingclot.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_punching/Se.pl: Wygląda na to, że został [i]niedawno uderzony...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_punching/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.en: Looks like someone's been using it to shave.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.pl: Wygląda na to, że ktoś się tu golił.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.en: There's a sink here, with its own little mirror.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.pl: Jest tu umywalka z małym lusterkiem.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_sinkmirror/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_suitcase/Se.pl: W środku są schludnie złożone ubrania.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_suitcase/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_suitcase/Se.pl: Pachnie jak, yy - [i]męska woda po goleniu...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_suitcase/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_teacup/Sect.en: I've been on this submarine for ages and nobody's offered [h]me[/h] a cup of tea.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_teacup/Sect.pl: Jestem na tej łodzi podwodnej całe wieki, a nikt nie zaoferował [h]mi[/h] filiżanki herbaty.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_teacup/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_wallnotes/S.en:
[i]Title Ideas:
Curse of the Captain
Scourge of the Sailor
Bane of the Bosun[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_wallnotes/S.pl:
[i]Pomysły na Tytuł:
Klątwa Kapitana
Sztorm Sternika
Bicz Bosmana[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_wallnotes/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.en: One good thing about living in a submarine:
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.pl: Jedna dobra rzecz w mieszkaniu na łodzi podwodnej:
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.en: Every window - has an ocean view.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.pl: Każde okno - ma widok na ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_DirkWirman_window/Sect.speaker: Sally
